findings.summary: Off-by-one in Intervals.icu page cap lets one extra page run past the stated bound.
findings.mechanism: hasMoreIntervals uses `payload.page <= MAX_INTERVALS_PAGES`, so when payload.page === 24 (MAX_INTERVALS_PAGES) it still queues and fetches page 25 before the check on page 25 finally stops it; the cap should be `payload.page < MAX_INTERVALS_PAGES` to actually stop at 24 pages as the adjacent comment claims ("2 months per page = ~4 years of history").
